skill_creation_review.local_assets: Only first-party contracts, templates, metadata, runtime, and tests are required; no third-party text or code is copied or adapted.

skill_creation_review.publisher_workflow: context-preserving-ai-publisher source-to-surface workflow with first-party _main source, deterministic copy outputs, routing/safety-matrix/README consumer updates, sync, and validation.
skill_creation_review.routing: The routing decision is explicit-only: github-governance-review-reconciler is routed only for the named N5 governance/review-reconciler contract.
